name: Junk Removal
tagline: Rubbish removal, cleanouts, e-waste, green waste
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional junk removal company. Ask what needs to be removed, the volume, access, and whether items are upstairs or in a basement. Ask about hazardous items, e-waste, and green waste. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise disposal of hazardous items that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: We hold [your insurance type] cover through [your insurer]. A certificate of currency is available on request.

kb.q: How much does junk removal cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Pricing depends on the load size, the items, and access. Tell us what needs to go and we will quote before we book.
We remove household junk, furniture, appliances, mattresses, e-waste, green waste, and construction waste. Ask us about anything unusual before you book.
Yes, we remove mattresses at the per-mattress rate in our price list. A recycling fee may apply, and we will show it in your quote.
Yes, we remove fridges, washing machines, dishwashers, and other large appliances. Tell us about any fridge or freezer when you book so we can plan the carry.
Yes, we take TVs, computers, printers, and other electronics for recycling. Tell us what you have, and we will confirm whether each item can be taken.
Yes, we remove branches, leaves, lawn clippings, and garden waste. Green waste is charged by the cubic metre.
Yes, we remove building and renovation waste such as timber, plasterboard, and rubble. Tell us the volume so we can quote the load size.
Yes, we do hoarding and estate cleanouts with care and discretion. These jobs are priced per hour, and we may need a site visit first.
Yes, we sort items for recycling and donate usable goods where possible. Tell us if you want certain items kept for donation.
Same-day junk removal is possible when we have space. Call early in the day, because availability changes quickly.
No, we do not take hazardous waste such as chemicals, asbestos, or liquid paint. Tell us about these items before we arrive so you can arrange safe disposal.
We take single items up to full truckloads. Load sizes are quarter, half, and full, and we quote based on what you tell us.
Yes, we do office and commercial clear-outs. Commercial jobs often need out-of-hours access, so tell us your site's access times.
Yes, we provide a receipt for every job. Disposal receipts are available on request.
We service [your service area] and the surrounding suburbs. Send us your suburb and we will confirm it is in range.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: It helps, but we can work with access arranged in advance. Tell us about keys, gates, or codes when you book.

kb.q: Can you remove items from upstairs?
kb.a: Yes, we can carry items from upstairs or a basement. A stairs surcharge applies, and we show it in the quote.
Yes, we take tyres for a fee. Tell us how many you have so we can quote.
We take dried paint only. Liquid paint is hazardous waste, and we cannot accept it.

templates.booking_confirmation: Hi {customer}, your {job} with {business} is booked for {date}.
templates.reminder: Reminder: {business} arrives on {date}. Please clear access and remove any loose items.
templates.quote_intro: Here is your quote for the {job}, based on what you told us about the volume and access.
templates.invoice_note: Thank you. Disposal receipts are available on request.

compliance.guidance: Waste carriers may need an EPA permit or registration in some states. Keep disposal records and do not accept hazardous waste without the correct handling plan. Check your EPA rules.
items: Waste carrier permit or registration where required
